summary: End-to-end testing of UnCopyright MVP. All 13 backend pytest tests pass (health, 4 reference endpoints w/ correct counts 20/4/3/20, Sarah demo w/ 5 events+5 files, work CRUD, analyze on demo returns 21 results with correct jurisdiction-differentiator on EV-02 (US=EXCLUDE, IN=UNCERTAIN, UK=POTENTIALLY_CLAIMABLE), fresh work→events→analyze flow returns 3 results, error handling on empty events / invalid jurisdiction / invalid work_type). Frontend flows all pass: Landing hero + jurisdiction pills + two CTAs; Sarah demo timeline (5 read-only events, no Add button); Contribution Map (5 qualitative rows, no percentages on bars); Jurisdiction Engine (3 cards preselected); Run legal analysis triggers toast '21 conclusions across 3 jurisdictions'; Legal Syllogism data-testids syllogism-EV-02-AI_GENERATED_MATERIAL-{IN,US,UK} carry claim-badge-{UNCERTAIN, EXCLUDE, POTENTIALLY_CLAIMABLE} respectively; Claim Matrix renders with color-coded badges; Evidence & Gaps opens; Lawyer Review shows memorandum + Export PDF button which invokes window.print(). Fresh flow (Launch → Visual → Upload → add event 'Human sketched concept' HUMAN + HUMAN_CONTRIBUTION → Run analysis) produces 3 conclusions.

issues: Upload category cards lack card-level data-testid (only the input has data-testid='upload-{key}-input'). Consider adding upload-card-{key} for stronger test coverage.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py init_storage() uses blocking requests inside async FastAPI event handler — acceptable at startup but put_object/get_object are also sync blocking on async endpoints; consider httpx.AsyncClient for scale.
In /works/{id}/analyze, per-request calls find_authority() is O(n) over 20 authorities × events × issues × jurisdictions — fine for MVP, index by (jurisdiction,work_type,issue) if scale grows.
legal_data.py has duplicated docstring on lines 1-2 (cosmetic).
MaterialUpload upload cards should carry data-testid='upload-card-{key}' for testability.
seed_data_creation: Test-created works (TEST_ prefixed) remain in Mongo; can be cleaned by dropping test DB
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_uncopyright_api.py — 13 tests covering all endpoints. Demo id: demo-sarah-visual-artwork. All frontend data-testids validated: landing-hero-title, btn-launch-workspace, btn-load-sarah-sample, jurisdiction-pills, timeline-events, timeline-event-EV-{01..05}, btn-add-event (hidden in demo), btn-timeline-continue, sidebar-step-*, btn-run-analysis, syllogism-{EV}-{ISSUE}-{IN|US|UK}, claim-badge-{POSITION}, claim-matrix-table, btn-export-pdf-dossier. Contribution-map step continue button is labelled 'Select Jurisdictions' (not 'Continue').
